description: Source code for a UDP socket implementation on the Starboard platform, including socket creation, binding, reading, writing, multicast, and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: UDPSocketStarboard
classes.description: Implementation of UDP socket operations for the Starboard platform, including socket management, data transmission, and asynchronous I/O.

classes.name: UDPSocketStarboardSender
classes.description: Helper class for sending UDP buffers on Starboard platform.

classes.name: WriteAsyncWatcher
classes.description: Inner class for monitoring socket readiness to write asynchronously.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Creates a new UDP socket with specified address family.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.

methods.name: ReadMultiplePackets
methods.description: Reads multiple packets in a batch using platform extension.

methods.name: RecvFrom
methods.description: Receives data from socket, optionally capturing sender address.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Sends data to a remote address.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects socket to a remote address.

methods.name: InternalConnect
methods.description: Internal method to handle connection logic.

methods.name: InternalWriteAsync
methods.description: Handles internal logic for async write.

methods.name: GetUnwrittenBuffers
methods.description: Retrieves buffers pending to be written.

methods.name: OnWriteAsyncTimerFired
methods.description: Timer callback to trigger pending writes.

methods.name: PostSendBuffers
methods.description: Posts buffers to task runner for sending.

methods.name: SetDoNotFragment
methods.description: Attempts to set Do Not Fragment (not supported).

methods.name: WatchSocketForWriting
methods.description: Starts watching socket for write readiness.

methods.name: StopWatchingSocketForWriting
methods.description: Stops watching socket for write readiness.

methods.name: StopWatchingSocketForReading
methods.description: Stops watching socket for read readiness.

methods.name: SetMaxPacketSize
methods.description: Sets maximum packet size for datagram buffer pool.

methods.name: ResetLastAsyncResult
methods.description: Resets and returns last async operation result.

methods.name: ResetWrittenBytes
methods.description: Resets and returns count of written bytes.
